skill.name: to-issues
skill.description: Break a plan, spec, or PRD into independently-grabbable issues on the project issue tracker using tracer-bullet vertical slices. Use when user wants to convert a plan into issues, create implementation tickets, or break down work into issues.
skill.summary: Convert engineering plans into approved, dependency-aware issue tracker tickets.
skill.author: mattpocock

content.value_statement: Large plans often become vague tickets that are hard to assign or verify. This skill turns plans into approved vertical slices with dependencies and issue bodies.
actual_capabilities: Breaks plans, specs, and PRDs into thin vertical slices.
Marks each slice as human-assisted or agent-ready work.
Identifies blockers and publishes issues in dependency order.
Creates issue bodies with parent links, scope, criteria, and blockers.
Applies the needs-triage label for normal project review.
limitations: Requires an available issue tracker and known label vocabulary.
Depends on user approval before publishing final issues.
Does not close, edit, or resolve parent issues.
May need codebase context to use the right domain language.

use_cases.title: Turn a PRD into tickets
use_cases.description: Convert a product requirement document into narrow issues that can be assigned and verified independently.

use_cases.title: Prepare implementation work
use_cases.description: Split a technical plan into agent-ready and human-assisted tasks before development begins.

use_cases.title: Refine an existing issue
use_cases.description: Use a large parent issue as source material and create smaller tracked issues with clear blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Break down a short plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a small feature plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use to-issues to split this plan into vertical issue slices. Ask for approval before publishing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a PRD
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured product work with acceptance criteria.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use to-issues on this PRD. Preserve the user stories and propose dependency order for the issue tracker.

prompt_templates.title: Use an existing parent issue
prompt_templates.scenario: A large issue needs smaller implementation tickets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use to-issues with this parent issue reference. Read the issue and comments, then draft smaller tracked slices.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a complex rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with dependencies and review needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use to-issues to create a rollout issue plan. Separate agent-ready work from human decision points and order blockers first.

output_examples.input: A checkout redesign plan with UI, API, and test work.
output_examples.output: A numbered slice list, including checkout shell, payment path, order confirmation, and regression coverage.

output_examples.input: A parent issue requesting authentication improvements.
output_examples.output: Approved child issue drafts with parent reference, acceptance criteria, blocker notes, and triage labeling.

output_examples.input: A migration plan that affects schema, backend services, and user settings.
output_examples.output: Dependency-ordered implementation issues that each deliver a testable path through the system.

best_practices: Provide the plan, issue tracker, and label vocabulary before starting.
Review the proposed slices before allowing issue publication.
Keep each issue independently demoable or verifiable.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to create broad layer-only tickets.
Do not publish issues before dependencies and scope are approved.
Do not expect it to make product decisions without human review.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates issue tracker tickets from a plan, spec, PRD, or parent issue.

faq.question: Does it publish issues automatically?
faq.answer: It drafts a breakdown first and asks for approval before publishing approved slices.

faq.question: What are tracer bullet slices?
faq.answer: They are narrow end-to-end tasks that deliver a complete and testable path through the system.

faq.question: Can it use existing issue comments?
faq.answer: Yes. If given an issue reference, it can read the full body and comments for context.

faq.question: Does it close parent issues?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly avoids closing or modifying parent issues.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
